en.name: St. Thomas Mount National Shrine Basilica, Chennai
en.summary: A hilltop shrine in Chennai marking the traditional site of the apostle Thomas's martyrdom.
en.body: Built by Portuguese settlers in the mid-sixteenth century atop a hill traditionally identified as the site of the apostle Thomas's martyrdom around AD 72, the church was designated a national shrine and, in 2025, raised to the rank of minor basilica.
